observed.github_cli_diagnostic: This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue.

root_cause.finding: jobs.<job_id>.env referenced ${{ runner.temp }} via OUTPUT_DIR; runner context is not available in jobs.<job_id>.env according to GitHub's context-availability table. The fix uses the runner-provided RUNNER_TEMP environment variable inside run steps.

recovery: Correct workflow source and output paths in a separate PR. The failed run had no job and did not invoke the candidate; do not re-run the failed run. The first candidate invocation will occur once on the repair PR's main push, if all one-shot prerequisites pass.
limits: This is a workflow infrastructure/validation STOP, not a scientific FAIL.
No candidate or independent audit execution occurred.
repair_summary: Use RUNNER_TEMP in runner shell steps, freeze input/candidate SHA-256 in both preflight and independent audit, commit failed-run status and upload execution-status.json on all outcomes, and require both pull/container steps to succeed in the audit-only workflow.
